name: Intel
description: Intel designs PC and server processors (Core, Xeon) and also runs its own chip factories. The filings treat it as two companies in one: Intel Products (the chip designers, selling to PC makers and data centers) and Intel Foundry (the factories, which make nearly all of Intel Products' chips and are trying to win outside customers). The product side earned a 26% operating margin on $49.1B of 2025 revenue; the foundry side lost $10.3B on $17.8B of mostly internal revenue. Intel also owns Mobileye and sold 51% of Altera in September 2025.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label (sector and sub-industry) read from Wikipedia, List of S&P 500 companies, on 2026-09-30 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies). That page gives only sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry are null because no source read states them. Labelled conventional filing only; Mowgli classification is not assigned here.

businessLines.name: Client Computing Group (CCG; renamed Client Computing and Physical AI Group, CCPG, in 2026)
businessLines.how: PC makers buy processors per chip; revenue follows PC unit volume and price mix (client ASPs rose 27% in Q2 2026 per the 10-Q).
businessLines.description: Platforms and processors for PCs and edge devices.

revenue.note: Segment revenue before eliminations; client (notebook and desktop) revenue $27.6B

businessLines.revenueNote: Segment revenue before eliminations; client (notebook and desktop) revenue $27.6B

businessLines.name: Data Center and AI (DCAI)
businessLines.how: Server CPUs and accelerators sold per unit to cloud and enterprise customers; the 10-Q attributes Q2 2026 growth mainly to server ASP increases.
businessLines.description: Xeon server CPUs, AI accelerators, NICs, IPUs and custom ASICs.

businessLines.name: Intel Foundry
businessLines.how: Charges Intel Products per wafer and for packaging at internal prices; external foundry customers were only $307M of 2025 revenue.
businessLines.description: Process technology development, manufacturing, packaging and foundry services.

revenue.note: Total segment revenue; $17.5B is intersegment (sold to Intel Products); external revenue was only $307M
